content: InfluxDB.Client (.NET) 5.0.0 QueryApi.QueryAsync executes raw Flux strings (including aggregateWindow+pivot) and streams FluxTable/FluxRecord results, or maps to POCOs. Recommended: build the aggregateWindow+pivot Flux query server-side (in the query string) rather than resampling client-side in .NET, since Influx already does the alignment natively and avoids shipping a resampling library in the orchestrator.
